title: Quiet Form
description: A small interface study about making room for a slower kind of browsing.
role: Independent concept · design and front-end exploration
process: A personal concept, made to explore type, restraint, and how an interface can feel welcoming without asking for attention.
result: An ongoing study in clear structure and softer details.

title: Afterlight
description: A digital field note on atmosphere, ambient light, and the last few minutes of a day.
role: Personal experiment · art direction and interaction
process: Started with a feeling rather than a feature list. The visual language stays quiet so the details can do the talking.
result: A work in progress. The best part is seeing what it becomes with time.

title: Little Moving Things
description: A place for short edits, visual notes, and the things I’m learning between cuts.
process: Collect small moments, find a rhythm in the edit, and let the imperfect bits stay human.
result: An archive in progress — footage and final edits will find their way here.
